response.sql: WITH per_order_avg AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as overall_avg FROM per_order_avg), first_filtered AS (SELECT poa.ordersmark, poa.avg_fillcount, (poa.avg_fillcount - oa.overall_avg) as margin_vs_overall FROM per_order_avg poa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE poa.avg_fillcount > oa.overall_avg), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as second_avg FROM first_filtered), final_filtered AS (SELECT ff.ordersmark, ff.avg_fillcount, ff.margin_vs_overall, (ff.avg_fillcount - sb.second_avg) as margin_vs_second FROM first_filtered ff CROSS JOIN second_benchmark sb WHERE ff.avg_fillcount > sb.second_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as avg_fill_per_order, AVG(margin_vs_overall) as avg_margin_vs_overall, AVG(margin_vs_second) as avg_margin_vs_second FROM final_filtered
